name: DU NEP 2022 Pattern (FYUP)
description: University of Delhi NEP 2022 Four Year Undergraduate Programme — 25 marks internal + 75 marks end semester, 5 units, 176 total credits over 8 semesters

in_semester.name: Internal Assessment
in_semester.notes: Internal assessment includes two periodic tests (weighted 15 marks) + assignments/presentations (10 marks). Practical courses have 50% internal assessment.

instructions: Answer any FIVE full questions, choosing at least ONE from each module.
Module 1: Q.1 or Q.2, Module 2: Q.3 or Q.4, Module 3: Q.5 or Q.6, Module 4: Q.7 or Q.8, Module 5: Q.9 or Q.10.
Neat diagrams must be drawn wherever necessary.

question_structure.description: Five modules each with an OR-pair. Each full question is 15 marks with sub-questions.
